As I return to tracking weekly the cost of milk, Diet Coke and eggs - these staples have sort of stayed the same. I am posting weekly.

Please send me prices you are worried about and I want to track them too. https://t.co/9QvAnLiyGy

From feedback last week, I am adding some more products mentioned for tracking. Milk costs the same this week. Eggs and Diet Coke up. Some cold medicines which people worried about are on on sale. Continuing to work on supply chain issues with hopes of getting these costs down. https://t.co/G7oq3PVDlE

Diet Coke, bread, milk, chicken, and ground beef have stayed the same. Eggs are down. Hot dogs are up. Lots of work ahead to fix COVID supply chain issues, but we are making progress and will get these costs down. https://t.co/dHo12nZStk

We know that food security & nutritious eating are vital for improving our health, reducing disease, & ensuring our children can grow & thrive.
 
@POTUS’ National Strategy on Hunger, Nutrition, & Health will combat hunger while building a healthier America for all.

Join me Friday, Oct. 7 at 11a for a roundtable discussion on combatting hunger in America.
 
I’ll be joined by experts on hunger, nutrition, & health to discuss the Biden Admin’s latest actions to help families keep food on the table. 

Watch LIVE on FB at https://t.co/yifiXH8ijr https://t.co/xlQAUWkkDl

Join me and area experts on hunger, nutrition, & health for a discussion on the Biden Administration's latest actions to help families keep food on the table.

https://t.co/jiPpqKHjtR

JFS Walk a Mile in My Shoes gives us the opportunity to consider the experiences that refugees live through every day. JFS is doing important work every day to support refugee resettlement needs, including housing, food & nutrition, employment services, and transportation. https://t.co/rQkOs84Yek

Team Dingell is proud to have won Best in Show & Funniest Pumpkin in this year’s Congressional Pumpkin Carving Contest. I have a great team & honestly my only contribution was my Diet Coke addiction.
 
More importantly, the contest benefits research for childhood brain cancer. https://t.co/zFLjOV1wcy

Joined local officials from Grosse Ile for a tour of the township’s wastewater treatment plant.

Proud to have secured a nearly $3.5M federal investment to make critical upgrades to the plant’s capacity & minimize overflows that impact water quality throughout the community. https://t.co/2d3xKjaTam

No one should forego care or treatment because they can’t afford it & no one should be forced into financial hardship to get the care they need. 

Together with Susan G Komen, I’m fighting to lift these barriers & ensure every American can get the care they need. https://t.co/osERoANJS7

Few people are stronger than my friend and colleague, Dan Kildee. I have no doubt he’ll face this diagnosis and recovery with the same force and dedication he brings to his work every day. I’m here for him and his family for whatever they need.

Patients should not have to worry whether they can access the scarce chemotherapy drugs they need on top of the daily stressors accompanied by a cancer diagnosis. We must do more to ease the troubling supply disruptions that put patients at risk.

No patient should have to forgo their necessary treatment just because one plant in India shut down. It’s time to bring our supply chains home and give @FDA the authority it needs to stop these shortages before they can put patients at risk.

59 years ago, President Johnson signed the Food Stamp Act into law, authorizing SNAP & providing millions of children, working families, seniors, & vets with access to nutritious meals. Today, @HouseDemocrats continue to fight to protect this vital nutrition program.

This #MentalIllnessAwarenessWeek, check in on your friends and family. Knowing the risk factors and warning signs can assist you in finding help for yourself, a loved one, or a friend. https://t.co/v32t47LuPO

.@UMich & @AARP are teaming up for a Healthy Aging Series to explore how older adults can live longer, healthier lives by providing research-based strategies & clinical expertise from UM & beyond. The sessions are free & open to the public. Register below. https://t.co/occpsXZH7P

Welcomed @EPAMichaelRegan to Ypsilanti and @YCUAnews today to learn more about planned upgrades to our wastewater treatment facilities made possible by historic federal investments in our water infrastructure. https://t.co/mofsnCIngo

Milk: $2.76 a gallon
Eggs: $1.89 a dozen
Diet Coke: $5.29 a six pack 
Natty trophy: priceless.

Proud to announce over $12 million for community projects in MI06. This long-awaited funding will go to 14 projects to improve local water treatment facilities & infrastructure, repair & upgrade roadways & sidewalks, develop & improve public spaces & more. https://t.co/hlhAMdt8zL

The #AffordableCareAct has been the difference between life and death for millions of Americans— work John’s father started, John continued, and I fight for every day because every person should be able to go to the doctor to get the medication and treatment they need. https://t.co/TPiiCQjVlG

Wishing the Princess of Wales much good health, courage, and strength as she navigates her diagnosis and treatment. She will show many throughout the world that early detection saves lives. Praying for her and her family as they give her all the support she needs.

Sending well wishes to @RepRaulGrijalva as he navigates his diagnosis. He is strong & fearless & I have no doubt he will continue showing us all what leadership looks like through these difficult circumstances. We are all with you & are praying for you & your loved ones.

April is Cancer Prevention and Early Detection Month! Routine screenings can mean better outcomes for your health—that means more treatment options, more healthy days ahead & more time with the people you love. Learn more: https://t.co/o5kdQZJKsB https://t.co/ZnTVlS7abq

It’s estimated that in 2024, around 19,680 new cases of ovarian cancer will be diagnosed in the US. I join @MIOvarianCancer for the Mother’s Day Time to Teal Race each year to raise awareness about early detection of ovarian cancer and support improved treatment outcomes. https://t.co/XwNSH2i3Ql

This National Cancer Survivors Day, we recommit to doing everything possible to support those affected by this disease & work to ensure research, treatment, & prevention programs have the necessary tools to bring us closer to a world where cancer is considered preventable.
